description: World Maps of the Köppen-Geiger Climate Classification is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate", published or maintained by World Bank Group. Two different maps of the Köppen-Geiger climate classification: World map of the Köppen-Geiger climate classification observed using CRU TS 2.1 temperature and GPCC Full v4 precipitation data, period 1976-2000. World map of the Köppen-Geiger climate classification projected using IPCC A1FI Tyndall SC 2.03 temperature and precipitation scenarios, period 2076-2100. Coverage: the whole world. It has 2 files in ZIP. The portal files it under Climate. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
